subject: Multi-Cell Compositional LSTM
source_sentence: Jia and Zhang (2020) presented a multi-cell compositional LSTM (Multi- Cell LSTM) structure where modeled each entity type as a separate cell state, and it reaches the state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance for cross - domain NER.
title: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition via Graph Matching

subject: Adapter
source_sentence: Except from the pretrain-finetune paradigm, some approaches proposed adding adap- tion layers Lin and Lu (2018) or adapter modules Houlsby et al. (2019) to the backbone network.

subject: Word Embedding
source_sentence: Furthermore, we enhance the contextual repre- sentation by fusing the constructed label graph into the word embedding by Graph Convolutional Net- to enhance domain adaptation ability in both low- resource and rich- resource scenarios.
title: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition via Graph Matching

subject: BERT
source_sentence: we fused the learned graph structure into the word contextual embedding output by BERT to model the sentence's semantic label relationships.
